stories.title: Leaked FIFA documents show Infantino’s 96-year private equity plan for World Cup
stories.summary: The leaked documents, including a FIFA in-house risk assessment, show its own finance officials “were not directly privy to the construction of this transaction”

stories.title: United States lined up to co-host 2034 men’s T20 World Cup with West Indies
stories.summary: The United States is being lined up to co-host the 2034 men’s T20 World Cup in a joint enterprise with West Indies. The International Cricket Council announced the dates of all global events until 2035 after their quarterly meeting in Bali last week, but has not confirmed any venues beyond the 50-over World Cup in 2031 in India and Bangladesh.

stories.title: India, New Zealand eye series win at Hagley Oval as WTC stakes add spice to Christchurch Test
stories.summary: India and New Zealand will look to settle their opening-Test stalemate when they meet in the second and final match of the series at Hagley Oval from Friday, with both teams hoping for a more sporting surface and India particularly keen to strengthen their World Test Championship (WTC) final prospects.

stories.title: IND A vs SL A, Rising Stars Asia Cup Semi-Final: Abhishek Sharma Gets Lucky! Sri Lanka Captain Pavan Rathnayake Drops Regulation Catch At Covers | Video
stories.summary: Sri Lanka A captain Pavan Rathnayake had an embarrassing moment on the field after dropping a straightforward catch of India's explosive opener Abhishek Sharma during the Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026 semi-final on Thursday. The Sri Lankan skipper failed to hold on to a regulation chance at cover, handing the Indian batter a crucial lifeline.

stories.title: How Rajasthan Royals missed once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to acquire Hardik Pandya
stories.summary: Ever since Mumbai Indians (MI) played their last league match of IPL 2026, speculation was rife over Hardik Pandya's future. Multiple teams were in the race to sign the flamboyant all-rounder, whose second stint with MI, having returned to the franchise in the 2024 season as captain, replacing long-serving skipper Rohit Sharma, didn't go as planned.

stories.title: Khawaja: Never expected Pat to come out and attack me personally
stories.summary: Australia opener Usman Khawaja has revealed that he was left deeply hurt by Pat Cummins' explosive press conference addressing the infamous 2018 Sandpapergate scandal. Khawaja admitted that he never expected the Australian captain to personally attack him while responding to allegations made in his recently released autobiography, Sabr.

stories.title: World chess championship: Gritty Gukesh weathers time pressure, holds Sindarov
stories.summary: There was this man-against-machine match in chess in 1998. If you thought the machine might have won, you are wrong. The man, named Viswanathan Anand, beat Fritz. The computer had white pieces and it opted for the Spanish Game. Anand, who hadn’t yet won any of his World titles yet, played the Berlin Defence.

stories.title: 'Gambhir, just look at how he is hitting': WC-winner sends strong message on Sooryavanshi
stories.summary: At just 15, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has already delivered several remarkable batting performances. But his stunning innings against the UAE in the Asia Cup Rising Stars could well be the most special of them all. Many former cricketers and experts have backed the youngster for a regular place in India's T20I team.

stories.title: Vedant Sehwag bags seven-wicket haul for brother Aaryavir-led Delhi vs Punjab
stories.summary: In a remarkable display of skill, Vedant Sehwag secured a stunning seven-wicket haul for Delhi U-19 in their match against Punjab U-19 during the Cooch Behar Trophy. His standout performance was instrumental in Delhi's triumph, aided by Nakul Yadav and others. This achievement not only reinforces the Sehwag cricket legacy but also signifies a promising chapter in Vedant's budding career, echoing the excellence of his father.

stories.title: Sahiba Bali's Gurpurab post with Arjun Kapoor sparks dating buzz, fans wonder 'is it a soft launch?'
stories.summary: Dating lives of celebrities are something every entertainment junkie is deeply interested in. And, with the strong presence of social media, fans often get to know about the whereabouts of their favourite actors. Something similar happened recently when actor and sports presenter Sahiba Bali uploaded a photo with actor Arjun Kapoor.

stories.title: India's top court tightens food warning labels in ne
stories.summary: NEW DELHI, - India's top court ruled on Thursday that separate warning labels should appear on the front of food packaging for every nutrient of concern, tightening a government proposal that called for a single label and dealing a blow to the $100 billion industry that has long opposed the measure.

stories.title: Knowledge Nugget | EPFO’s new rules explained: From easier PF withdrawals to payout plan for retirees
stories.summary: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), at the meeting of its Central Board of Trustees (CBT) on November 19, 2026, approved key changes to Provident Fund (PF) withdrawal rules. These include reducing the waiting period for final PF settlement after unemployment from 12 months to two months, lowering the minimum balance that members must retain in their accounts from 25% to 10%, and introducing a Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP).

stories.title: In a nation of chai drinkers, Darjeeling’s prized tea is a sliver of the crop. Its history and troubles | HT Explainers
stories.summary: Union commerce and industry minister Piyush Goyal said last week the government was working to restore the glory of Darjeeling tea – the first Indian product to win a geographical indication (GI) tag – at a time when the hills are growing less tea than they did a generation ago and the industry is struggling.

stories.title: Why has the FSSAI sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri? | Explained
stories.summary: On November 22, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), the country’s apex food-safety regulator, sanctioned prosecution against packaged drinking water manufacturer Bisleri International Pvt. Ltd. after a sample of its water was found to be non-compliant with prescribed safety standards, with the regulator declaring it unsafe under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

stories.title: Maharashtra's new property card plan: What flat owners, homebuyers need to know
stories.summary: The Maharashtra government has proposed issuing separate property cards for individual flats in buildings, recording ownership details, sanctioned area, associated rights, mortgages and other liabilities. The proposed system, called the Vertical Property Card, aims to create an independent supplementary record of rights for every eligible flat or unit, alongside existing land records.

stories.title: Flu and other winter viruses can hit older adults harder – here’s what you need to know
stories.summary: “Put a coat on or you’ll catch a cold.” It is a familiar warning, but it leaves out the most important character in the story, the virus. For older people, there is a further concern. Infections such as flu and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) , a common virus that can cause a runny nose or a cough, are more likely to lead to serious illness in this age group.

stories.title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Privacy Display explained: What is it and how it works
stories.summary: Samsung’s Privacy Display is a feature built into the Galaxy S26 Ultra that makes the screen harder to read from the side. With the feature enabled, the display directs more light forward, so text and images are easier to see when you look straight at the phone. How Samsung’s Privacy Display worksSamsung calls the technology behind it Flex Magic Pixel.

stories.title: KPSC recruitment scam in Karnataka: How question papers and answer keys reached candidates ahead of exams | Explained
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has alleged that senior Karnataka Public Service Commission (KPSC) officials, including its then Chairman Shivashankarappa Sahukar and Controller of Examinations Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar, were involved in leaking question papers and answer keys for the recruitment of 400 veterinary officers. The alleged leak involved a network of commission officials, middlemen and candidates, with crores of rupees changing hands.

stories.title: From refined sugar to jaggery: What you need to know before switching your everyday sweetener
stories.summary: Jaggery is often considered healthier than white sugar, but here are the nutritional differences that may surprise you. Swapping sugar with jaggery feels virtuous. But according to a gut-healthy nutritionist, your body barely notices the difference. In an interview with HT Lifestyle, Rashi Chowdhary, chief nutritionist at Nutrition In Sync, explained the nutritional differences so that you can make an informed decision.

stories.title: Why India is betting Rs 11,000 crore on construction, infrastructure equipment manufacturing - explained
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved an Rs 11,000-crore scheme to strengthen India's construction and infrastructure equipment (CIE) manufacturing ecosystem, with a focus on increasing domestic production, supporting component makers and setting up a dedicated testing facility.The decisions were announced by Union minister Ashwini Vaishnaw at a press briefing following the Cabinet meeting chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.The Scheme for Enhancement of Construction and Infrastructure Equipment Manufacturing Ecosystem will be implemented by the Ministry of…

stories.title: What does ₹1.25L monthly budget look like? ‘ ₹30,000 grocery, ₹20,000 grooming’: Noida couple’s expenses go viral
stories.summary: Owning a home does not always mean that monthly expenses are low. 25 lakh every month, even though they own their house and do not have to pay rent. The couple shared a video on Instagram explaining their monthly expenses. Their spending includes groceries, household help, gym memberships , grooming, food and travel.

stories.title: Who qualifies as a journalist? SC to ponder question of protection for scribes
stories.summary: New Delhi, The Supreme Court on Thursday said it will consider who qualifies to be a journalist and whether accredited media persons should enjoy greater protection than self-proclaimed reporters while covering protests. A bench comprising Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana observed that journalistic freedom has to be balanced with the administration of public order and law.

stories.title: Who Is Lakshmi Venu And Why Is She Seeking Partition Of TVS Family's Wealth Under Hindu Succession Act?
stories.summary: Industrialist Lakshmi Venu has demanded partition of joint family assets belonging to the Venu Srinivasan branch of the TVS family, intensifying the ongoing dispute over family wealth and succession rights. Lakshmi is the daughter of TVS Group Chairman Emeritus Venu Srinivasan and Tractors and Farm Equipment Limited (TAFE) Chairman Mallika Srinivasan.
